yankalilla-7.name: Rapid Bay
yankalilla-7.bio: A long jetty and sheltered bay on the Fleurieu's western coast, used for fishing, diving and snorkelling.

notes.pin: draft pin from Wikipedia article; check against jetty/beach

yankalilla-8.name: Talisker Conservation Park
yankalilla-8.bio: Ruins of an 1860s silver-lead mine on a 1.4 km interpretive circuit with a lookout towards Kangaroo Island.

notes.pin: draft is a rounded Wikipedia point; use mine-ruins car park / circuit midpoint
notes.closure: NPWS SA alert (deep-creek page): Talisker Conservation Park is closed until further notice for public safety after an active fire. Keep as spot (permanent place) but flag; consider re-check before release.

yankalilla-8.ticket_note: NPWS page parks.sa.gov.au/parks/talisker-conservation-park returns 404; park has no fee page found

yankalilla-9.name: Ingalalla Falls
yankalilla-9.bio: A two-tier waterfall and rock pool at the end of an easy 700 m return walk through Second Valley Forest.

notes.pin: draft from Wikipedia; walk is ~700 m return so the waterfall point is the right pin; confirm with OSM waterfall node

yankalilla-9.ticket_note: forest reserve walk; no official site verified

yankalilla-10.name: Blowhole Beach
yankalilla-10.bio: A remote Southern Ocean beach in Deep Creek National Park, reached by a walking track.

notes.pin: Blowhole Creek carpark/trailhead in Deep Creek NP, then the beach end of the track; use OSM natural=beach
notes.cost: NPWS SA Deep Creek NP page: vehicle entry $14.40 per vehicle
notes.closure: Parts of Deep Creek NP remain closed after bushfire; check the park alerts for the Blowhole Creek area

yankalilla-11.name: Morgans Beach
yankalilla-11.bio: An 800 m sandy cove beneath 50 m glacial cliffs at Cape Jervis, with a clifftop lookout and reef to explore.

yankalilla-12.name: Tunkalilla Beach
yankalilla-12.bio: A remote Southern Ocean beach reached on foot, where seals and dolphins are often seen offshore.

notes.pin: beach end of Tunkalilla Beach walk; Wikipedia article 'Tunkalilla' is the locality (check article is the beach; drop wiki if it is only the locality)
notes.cost: assumed free; not confirmed from an official page

yankalilla-13.name: Fishery Beach
yankalilla-13.bio: A beach close to Cape Jervis, at the western tip of the Fleurieu Peninsula.

notes.pin: OSM natural=beach named Fishery Beach near Cape Jervis

yankalilla-14.name: Myponga Reservoir Reserve
yankalilla-14.bio: A reservoir reserve open for walking, fishing and kayaking, with kangaroos and a view from the dam wall.

notes.pin: draft is the Wikipedia dam point; use the reserve's visitor car park / dam wall lookout
notes.cost: assumed free; SA Water recreation page not verified

yankalilla-15.name: Myponga Beach
yankalilla-15.bio: A surf beach on the western Fleurieu coast, with a car park and toilets right at the sand.
